eventDetail.scope: CTIEET 2026 will unite global researchers, engineers, and scholars to share advances in computer technology, information engineering, and electronic technology. It will cover major areas such as big data algorithms, quantum computing, high-performance parallel computing, cloud-edge synergy, intelligent computing, network privacy, and blockchain security. Information engineering topics will include big data mining, multi-source fusion, multimedia processing, data visualization, wireless network topology, and cloud data center optimization. Electronic research areas will involve embedded design and AI, sensor sensing, intelligent control, wearable electronics, and signal detection. The conference will feature keynote talks and technical sessions to promote academic exchange and cross-disciplinary collaboration, driving breakthroughs, technical progress, and industrial applications in computing, information, and electronics.
